capture_policy: Bounded factual paraphrases by the primary reviewer. Full source/tool responses are retained privately. Web tool retrieval date is 2026-11-08; a precise retrieval timestamp is not claimed. Shared raw-source hashes and actual access timestamps are bound separately in capture-retention.json.

facts: Eubacterium medium uses BD 211260 fluid thioglycollate medium at 29.5 g/L, with separate yeast extract and sodium thioglycollate.
This corroborates TOGO M148/JCM157 product identity; it does not identify a single thioglycollate salt as the whole product.

facts.locator: ATCC medium 177, commercial preparation and separate scratch formula
facts: Commercial preparation names BD 211260 at 29.5 g per litre of water.

A separate scratch formula lists yeast extract, Casitone peptone, dextrose, NaCl, L-cystine, sodium thioglycollate, agar and resazurin. That alternative is not treated as a certified dry-product formulation.

facts.locator: Methods, page 968, Chemicals; Organisms, growth, harvesting of cells
facts: Racemic sulfolactate was synthesized by the Roy et al. 2003 method.
Chromohalobacter salexigens DSM3043 grew aerobically at 30 C with 10 mM (R,S)-sulfolactate in Tris-buffered artificial seawater with ammonium chloride and vitamins.
The exact organism, reference and 10 mM carbon substrate match frozen MEDIADB:16/CultureMech:015430.

facts.locator: Materials and Methods, Chemicals, paragraph beginning sodium sulfolactate
facts: Sodium sulfolactate was prepared by acidic diazotization/deamination of L-cysteic acid, using 2 M acetic acid in place of hydrochloric acid.

The paragraph does not state sodium stoichiometry or hydrate form. Its sodium-salt identification applies through the explicit Denger 2010 synthesis citation; no exact molecular formula or CAS is inferred.
BD catalog 211260 names BBL fluid thioglycollate medium, 500 g.

facts.locator: Trypticase (Tryptic) Soy Broth, lines 438-445 in web view
facts: The compendium explicitly uses Trypticase and Tryptic as names for soy broth.
Its standard broth lists trypticase peptone 17 g, Phytone peptone 3 g, NaCl 5 g, K2HPO4 2.5 g and glucose 2.5 g per litre; a glucose-free variant is separately described.
This is a generic named-broth contrast; it does not prove an unspecified BBL catalog used in NBRC957/1045 is exactly this formulation.

facts.locator: Definition, formula, structure and CAS xref
facts: CHEBI:75228 is sodium lactate, formula C3H5O3.Na, with a stereochemically unspecified structure and CAS72-17-3.
The term does not encode a concentration or a pure L enantiomer.
Sigma71720 is sodium DL-lactate, CAS72-17-3, supplied as powder.
This verifies the named racemic salt; it does not establish the supplier or concentration of MediaDive943.
CHEBI:132767 denotes ferric pyrophosphate with Fe(III) and diphosphate in a 4:3 ratio, formula4Fe.3O7P2 and CAS10058-44-3.
Fe4(PO4)2 is not this formula; correcting the current owner label does not establish the identity intended by the malformed source string.

facts.locator: Parent term and incoming is_a relations
facts: The parent thymidine5'-monophosphate has no displayed definition or molecular formula; children include neutral dTMP(CHEBI:17013) and dTMP anion(CHEBI:46960).
An unspecified parent is not used to bypass MIM's explicit protonation rule.

facts.locator: Definition, chemical structure and conjugate relation
facts: CHEBI:17013 explicitly denotes the neutral thymidine5'-monophosphate species, CAS365-07-1.
The label dTMP alone does not report the supplied salt or the medium pH in the two admitted Song-medium records.
Pyrroloquinoline quinone, PQQ and methoxatin name the neutral acid product CAS72909-34-3, formulaC14H6N2O8.
PQQ disodium products are separately named; this is a naming convention and form contrast, not proof that NBRC1394 purchased this supplier.

facts.locator: Term label, exact-synonym annotation and BBL formula annotation
facts: The active MICRO0000113 term is tryptic soy broth. Its exact-synonym annotation includes Trypticase soy broth.
The definition identifies liquid medium containing pancreatic casein digest, papaic soybean digest, glucose, NaCl and dipotassium phosphate.
The BBL formula annotation specifies 17, 3, 2.5, 5 and 2.5 g/L respectively, with pH7.3 +/-0.2. The no-dextrose product is separately named.
These factual fields support the generic named broth and standard formulation; they do not imply all product lots or supplemented NBRC media are identical.

facts.locator: Active term label, definition annotation and exact synonym annotation
facts: MICRO:0000541 is R2A medium, with R2A broth and Reasoner's 2A as exact synonyms.
The definition explicitly describes a liquid medium containing yeast extract, proteose peptone, casamino acids, glucose, starch and pyruvate.
The separate historical source annotation includes an agar formula. That formula is not used to add agar or quantitative composition to this liquid-medium owner.
